cards.title: Multi-Board Export with Dropdown Selector
cards.description:
**Status in Doc:** Not Started

**Overview:**
Add ability to export multiple boards at once through a dropdown selector in the export modal. Users can select individual boards or "All Boards" option.

**Key Requirements:**
- Dropdown board selector in ExportModal
- "All Boards" option
- Multi-board JSON format support
- Individual board export maintained

**Notes:**
- Export functions exist (`exportAllBoardsAIOptimized`)
- UI needs board selector dropdown
- May already be partially implemented

cards.title: Stack Junkie Universal Style Guide v0.3 Alignment
cards.description:
**Status in Doc:** Not Started

**Overview:**
Align Chronica's color system, typography, and component styling with Stack Junkie Universal Style Guide v0.3 for consistent design language across projects.

**Key Requirements:**
- Update color palette to style guide colors
- Align typography (font sizes, weights, line heights)
- Update component styling
- Maintain dark mode compatibility

**Notes:**
- Foundation for design consistency
- High complexity (2-3 days)
- No dependencies on other features

cards.title: Column Color Mode Toggle
cards.description:
**Status in Doc:** Planned

**Overview:**
Add toggle in Settings to switch between two column coloring modes:
1. **Card Color Mode** (current): Cards have colors, columns are neutral
2. **Column Color Mode** (new): Columns have colors, cards inherit/neutral

**Key Requirements:**
- Settings toggle for color mode
- Persist mode in config
- Update column rendering logic
- Maintain backward compatibility

**Notes:**
- Medium priority
- 1-2 days effort
- Targeted for v0.1.0-alpha.7

cards.title: Windows Installer Build and Distribution
cards.description:

cards.title: Board-Level Card Fields System
cards.description:
**Status:** ✅ COMPLETED (2025-11-04)

**Overview:**
Refactored card field system from global (config-level) to board-level, with support for card-specific one-off fields.

**Problem Solved:**
- Boards now have independent field definitions
- No more field conflicts on import
- Board-specific fields (e.g., "Sprint" only on sprint boards)
- Card-only fields for one-off custom data

**3-Tier System Implemented:**
1. **Global Template** (Settings) → blueprint for new boards
2. **Board Fields** (per board) → independent fields accessed via ⚙️ menu
3. **Card-Only Fields** (per card) → one-off fields in card editor

**What Was Built:**
- ✅ Type updates (Card, Board, Config)
- ✅ boardStore updates (createBoard, importBoard, updateBoardFields)
- ✅ configStore migration logic (fields → defaultFieldTemplate)
- ✅ Import/Export updated (board.fields support)
- ✅ ImportModal simplified (no more field conflicts)
- ✅ Board Edit Menu (⚙️ icon → "Card Fields")
- ✅ BoardFieldEditor component (NEW)
- ✅ FieldManager refactored (accepts props, shows context)
- ✅ CardEditor card-only fields UI (+ Add Field button)
- ✅ SettingsModal template labels
- ✅ TypeScript & Vite build passing

**Files Modified:** 11 files  
**Files Created:** 1 file (BoardFieldEditor.tsx)  
**Total Changes:** ~400 lines
